Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Configures the native block sizes of a PostgreSQL AllocSet memory context.

```csharp
public sealed class PgMemoryContextOptions
```

Sizes are validated when creating a context. Nonzero sizes must satisfy the target PostgreSQL
server's alignment requirements; the native bridge also validates version-specific size limits.
Blocks need not be powers of two, and the minimum context size may exceed the initial block size.

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)

Parameters:

`minimumContextSize` — [nuint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uintptr)

The retained first-block size, or zero to use the initial block size.

`initialBlockSize` — [nuint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uintptr)

The first ordinary allocation block size.

`maximumBlockSize` — [nuint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uintptr)

The largest ordinary allocation block size.

Sizes are validated when creating a context. Nonzero sizes must satisfy the target PostgreSQL
server's alignment requirements; the native bridge also validates version-specific size limits.
Blocks need not be powers of two, and the minimum context size may exceed the initial block size.
